title: Raycast generated-import acceptance

instructions: In the visible disposable VM, finish Raycast onboarding if it appears, then return to the generated import prompt opened by the apply.
Start a screen recording before accepting the generated import and keep the Raycast import UI visible.
Accept the import in Raycast, enter the recipe's default import password 12345678 if prompted, and verify that it completes without an error or unsupported-file message.
Open Raycast Settings > General and visibly show Launch Raycast at login enabled and the configured Command-Space Raycast hotkey before ending the recording.
acceptance: Raycast accepts the generated import artifact without an error.
The same recording shows Raycast Settings > General with Launch Raycast at login enabled and the Command-Space hotkey configured.
The retained video contains the import acceptance and the corresponding visible setting state as one continuous operator-observed sequence.

artifact.description: Operator-captured Raycast import acceptance followed by the visible General settings state.

cleanup: Quit Raycast after the recording is complete.
After copying the run directory to the host, stop and delete the disposable UTM clone.
Delete failed run directories; retain a successful run directory only when its finalized manifest will retain those artifacts.
